mechanism: Clobazam is metabolized by CYP3A4 to its active metabolite N-desmethylclobazam, and isotretinoin is also metabolized via CYP3A4, creating potential for competitive inhibition and altered drug levels.
action: Monitor clobazam levels and seizure control; consider dose adjustment if needed; counsel on teratogenicity precautions with isotretinoin (strict contraception required).
